title: Log
hint: Four levels. The two deep ones switch themselves off after an hour. Never the content of {things}, passwords or keys.
levelHint: A filter always shows the higher levels too: “WARNING” includes the errors.
fixed: The level is set in {variable} and cannot be changed here.
clearText: Every line is removed. New ones come as before.
failed: That did not work just now. Try again in a moment.
